description: Of Bailey, Byrnes said she is a proven, dedicated public servant who is knowledgeable about the issues affecting the community and has a strong work ethic. “I trust her,” Byrnes said of Bailey, “and I endorse her for the 133rd Assembly seat.”

title: Byrnes will not seek re-election in 2024; endorses Bailey for 133rd Assembly seat
